title: Australian politics live: federal Liberal senator Leah Blyth reportedly defects to One Nation

blocks.text:
• Get our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcast

Federal Liberal senator for South Australia, Leah Blyth, is defecting to One Nation and will become the party’s first upper house member for the state, according to the Australian.

The move will cause recriminations in Coalition ranks because Blyth is a member of Angus Taylor’s shadow cabinet.

I can no longer in good conscience tell Australians that the Liberal party can save this country.

Australia is a country worth fighting for … I want our children to grow up proud of their country, with the freedom and opportunity to build a better life.

The difference this year was countries were a lot harder to budge from their position and frankly I felt a lot of geopolitical tension in the room on other issues infecting the conversation and making it so much harder to negotiate.

I’ve been to five Cops, seen plenty of argy-bargy but there was a lot more rigidness to the negotiations this year.

We [Australia] have always supported transition away from fossil fuels. This year I had a slightly different job. Normally we go – I go – to Cops and argue for what should be in.
